attributes.name: text_column_measure
attributes.definition: Whether prose/intro text is constrained to a narrow reading column versus full container width.

values.definition: Text is limited to a narrow measure/column (e.g. ~770px or narrow left-aligned column).
Text spans the full container width.

attributes.name: card_list_arrangement
attributes.definition: How repeated cards or items (people, communities, FAQ entries) are arranged in a section.

values.definition: Cards laid out side by side in multi-column rows.
Cards stacked vertically in a single centered column.

attributes.name: grid_last_row_completeness
attributes.definition: Whether the final row of a content grid is filled or leaves empty columns.

values.definition: Last row has fewer items than columns, leaving empty slots.

attributes.name: above_fold_composition
attributes.definition: What the first screen contains and how continuous it is.

values.definition: Header, hero banner and call to action in a continuous flow without blank gaps.
Hero present but with blank gaps or spacing breaks.
First screen has no hero banner.

attributes.name: eyebrow_label_style
attributes.definition: Style of the small label above a heading or article.

values.definition: Small-caps eyebrow label in an accent colour such as gold.

attributes.name: section_view_all_link
attributes.definition: Presence and placement of a 'View All' style link on a section header.

values.definition: Accent-coloured link at the section's top right.

attributes.name: faq_heading_format
attributes.definition: How FAQ question headings are formatted.

values.definition: Questions numbered and marked up as H3.
Not numbered or other heading level.
